request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere, and no number anywhere except the one house number described: no other signs, plates, mailboxes, clocks, screens or clothes show any digit.

Keep the people and the thing that carries the meaning inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

Only these two people are in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.

It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.

Two real identical twin boys of twelve, with the same face, the same short black hair and the same green T-shirts, sit side by side at a table in a bright living room and smile at the camera. In front of each boy is his own small round chocolate birthday cake on a white plate, and on each cake stand two large, thick number candles that read 1 and 2 together as the number 12, each candle as tall as the boy's hand, with a small flame. The candle numbers face the camera and are sharp and easy to read even on a small phone screen. There is no number anywhere except the two cakes' candles.
